 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed
chargesheet against Accused no.1 for the offences punishable U/s.
498A, 504 of Ipc.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the
first information statement of Smt.Kruthika .S.

The gist of the
prosecution case

is that the Accused No.1 got married to Cw-1 on
10-06-2020 at Sri Venkateshwara swamy temple, Thalaghattapura.
After the marriage, Cw-1 started residing with the Accused No.1,

3

while staying the Accused No.1 to 4 used to picked up quarrel with
Cw-1 for silly matters and teasing her as she do not know
household work, Accused No.4 inducing Accused No.1 to do ill will
acts, the Accused No.2 and 3 were listening near the bed room of
Cw-1 and Accused No.1 and 2 expressed that they would have
arrange a marriage of Accused No.1 with Government servant and
experienced one. Accused No.1 forcing Cw-1 to take videos of the
bedroom tortured her both by physically and mentally in demand of
additional dowry.

In continuation of the above said offence, on 19-

11-2020 when Cw-1 refused to get abort, accused No.1 to 4 with
common intention picked up quarrel with Cw-1 abused Cw-1 in
filthy words and left her in the house of Cw-1.

Based on the said
information, a case in Cr.No.87/2022 came to be registered against
the accused for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of
Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused
for the aforesaid offences.

On receipt of charge sheet, this court
took cognizance of the alleged offences.

Pursuant to the issuance
and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were
enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the
accused No.1 to 4 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4
 C.C.No.26738/2022
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was
provided to the accused No.1 to 4 after hearing them and the
prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for
the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the
accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused
pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

The plea of the accused
No.1 to 4 was recorded.

Thereafter, the matter was set down for
prosecution evidence.

5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has
examined Pw-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As
there were no any incriminating circumstances in the evidence
against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s.313
of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.

6. Heard arguments on both the sides.

I have Perused the
materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable
 doubt that the accused persons caused physical and
 mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry
 and threatened her and thereby accused have committed
 the offences punishable U/s.498A, 504 of Ipc.?
 2) what order?
 5
 C.C.No.26738/2022
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 Reasons
 9.

Point No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal
jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond
reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as Pw-1 got marked
Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.

Ex.P1 is the first information
statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. Cw-1 was examined as Pw-1 Smt.Kruthika.S..

She in her
examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused
No.1 was performed on 10-06-2020 and deposed after the
marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused
did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in
demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened
Basavanagudi

4

to kill her.

Pw-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her
and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the
police station.

There the police have took her signatures on
 6
 C.C.No.26738/2022
documents.

Pw-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and
also identified her signature at Ex.P1.

Pw-1 also identified Ex.P.2
spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her
ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.

The learned Sr.APP
treated Pw-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.

During
which Pw-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the
matter and denied all other suggestions.
 11.

On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is
apparent that Pw-1 being the informant, key and material witness
have turned hostile to the prosecution case.

Therefore, this court
was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon
other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to
other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the
material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also
the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge
sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was
taken as closed. In view of the material witness, turning hostile the
prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused
beyond reasonable doubt.

Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the
Negative.

 12.

the following:
